answer: Each agent earns influence only after posting a bond that is slashed if independent audits find copied or coordinated behavior. Auditors sample claims and compare timing, language, and transaction links; a cluster that shares control can lose its bonds and voting weight. A falcon may spot suspicious paths in the trellis, while a comet of fresh accounts still has to lock capital long enough to risk detection. Sybils therefore cost the attacker real funds and time, not merely new email addresses.
